title: Why a Worrisome Economy Doesn’t Seem to Worry Trump

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星辰之外是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As President Trump has rolled out his economic agenda, the assumption was that he would quickly
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普总统推出他的经济议程，人们本以为他会迅速

sentences.en: scale back his most aggressive policies once they began to scare consumers and the financial markets.
sentences.zh: 缩减其最激进的政策，一旦这些政策开始让消费者和金融市场感到恐慌。

sentences.en: That assumption turned out to be wrong.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这种假设是错的。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues, economics reporter Ben Kasselman and White House reporter Maggie
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、经济记者本·卡塞尔曼和白宫记者玛吉·

sentences.en: Haberman on why the Trump economic plan may be backfiring and why Trump doesn't seem to mind.
sentences.zh: 哈伯曼将为我们探讨为什么特朗普的经济计划可能会适得其反，以及为什么特朗普似乎并不介意。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月21日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hey, Ben.
sentences.zh: 嘿，本。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Good to have you back in the studio.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你回到演播室。

sentences.en: It's been a while.
sentences.zh: 好久不见了。

sentences.en: It has been a while.
sentences.zh: 确实好久不见了。

sentences.en: Happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: As you know, we're two months into the Trump administration and therefore two months into the Trump economy.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，特朗普政府上台已经两个月了，因此特朗普经济学也推行了两个月。

sentences.en: And he comes to office with a set of sweeping economic promises that the business community and the stock market and polling shows Americans generally are very excited about.
sentences.zh: 他上任时带着一系列大刀阔斧的经济承诺，商业界、股市以及民调都显示美国人对此普遍感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: More prosperity, lower costs, lower regulation, lower taxes.
sentences.zh: 更多的繁荣、更低的成本、更少的监管、更低的税收。

sentences.en: The market booms when he gets elected.
sentences.zh: 他当选时市场一片欢腾。

sentences.en: Stock market is surging.
sentences.zh: 股市飙升。

sentences.en: And then Trump starts to actually put his fingerprints on the economy.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普开始真正将他的手腕施加到经济上。

sentences.en: And the stock market has, over the past few weeks, been plunging.
sentences.zh: 而在过去几周里，股市一直在暴跌。

sentences.en: And now the Federal Reserve is telling us that the country's financial outlook is pretty unsteady.
sentences.zh: 现在美联储告诉我们，国家的财务前景相当不稳定。

sentences.en: And Trump himself is now acknowledging that his plans may wreak a certain amount of havoc on the economy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人现在也承认，他的计划可能会对经济造成一定程度的混乱。

sentences.en: So a lot has changed very quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以很多事情变化得非常快。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's worth winding back a little bit to what Trump inherited in the economy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，值得回溯一下特朗普接手的经济状况是什么样的。

sentences.en: Because by many measures, it was pretty solid, right?
sentences.zh: 因为从许多指标来看，它相当稳固，对吧？

sentences.en: Unemployment was low.
sentences.zh: 失业率很低。

sentences.en: Job growth was solid.
sentences.zh: 就业增长稳健。

sentences.en: Corporate profits were good, right?
sentences.zh: 企业利润很好，对吧？

sentences.en: There were a lot of things that were pretty good.
sentences.zh: 有很多方面都相当不错。

sentences.en: We know there was one really big thing that was not good, right?
sentences.zh: 我们知道有一个非常大的方面不太好，对吧？

sentences.en: Which was inflation.
sentences.zh: 那就是通货膨胀。

sentences.en: It had gotten a lot better.
sentences.zh: 情况已经好转了很多。

sentences.en: But we know cost of living had gone up.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道生活成本上涨了。

sentences.en: And that was in inflation.
sentences.zh: 这体现在通胀中。

sentences.en: And it was in housing prices.
sentences.zh: 也体现在房价中。

sentences.en: And it was in all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 还体现在各种各样的事情中。

sentences.en: And we know that Americans did not feel good about the economy, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道美国人对经济感觉并不好，对吧？

sentences.en: That was a big part of the reason that Trump was brought back to office in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这也是特朗普当初重新当选总统的一个重要原因。

sentences.en: So, as you said, when he is elected, there's a surge in optimism among businesses.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如你所说，当他当选时，企业界的乐观情绪高涨。

sentences.en: There's a surge of optimism among many consumers.
sentences.zh: 许多消费者的乐观情绪也高涨。

sentences.en: There was this sense, right, of the economy was actually in pretty good shape, according to the economists.
sentences.zh: 当时有一种感觉，根据经济学家的说法，经济状况其实相当不错。

sentences.en: And now it was maybe also in good shape, according to everybody else.
sentences.zh: 而现在，在其他人看来，可能状况也相当不错。

sentences.en: And yet, in the last few weeks, all of that has turned around.
sentences.zh: 然而，在过去的几周里，这一切都逆转了。

sentences.en: All of that.
sentences.zh: 这一切。

sentences.en: Markets are way down.
sentences.zh: 市场大幅下跌。

sentences.en: Consumer confidence is way down.
sentences.zh: 消费者信心大幅下降。

sentences.en: Business confidence, crucially, is way down.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，商业信心也大幅下降。

sentences.en: And so all of these measures of how consumers, how businesses, how investors feel about the economy have all taken a really sharp turn to the south.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些衡量消费者、企业和投资者对经济看法的指标都出现了急剧的急转直下。

sentences.en: Now, that's how people feel.
sentences.zh: 现在，这只是人们的感受。

sentences.en: So far, most of the measures of actual activity, of what consumers are doing, of what businesses are doing, have not shown that same sharp deterioration.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大多数衡量实际活动的指标——消费者在做什么、企业在做什么——还没有显示出同样急剧的恶化。

sentences.en: But the risk, Ben, and I've learned this from you over the years, is that those eroding confidence and sentiment numbers become a self-fulfilling prophecy
sentences.zh: 但风险在于，本，这些年来我从你身上学到的是，那些不断侵蚀的信心和情绪指数会变成自我实现的预言

sentences.en: and they end up dragging down the hard economic numbers that you just referred to.
sentences.zh: 并最终拖累你刚才提到的硬性经济数据。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think that's particularly a risk in a situation like this where the drop is so sharp and with a very clear set of reasons.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为在目前这种情况下风险尤其大，因为跌幅如此之急，而且有着非常明确的原因。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about those reasons.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这些原因。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the mechanics of these confidence numbers falling so precipitously.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈这些信心指数如此急剧下跌的机制。

sentences.en: In my mind, there are two major things that the president has done that have affected the economy.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，总统所做的两件大事影响了经济。

sentences.en: I mean, to what degree, I don't quite understand.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，程度到底有多深，我并不是很理解。

sentences.en: The first being his very aggressive and abrupt efforts to shrink the government, laying off thousands of workers, closing agencies.
sentences.zh: 首先是他非常激进且突然的精简政府举措，裁员数千名工人，关闭机构。

sentences.en: And the second, of course, is the tariffs he's imposed on goods imported into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，其次是他对进口到美国的商品征收的关税。

sentences.en: Let's start with the cost-cutting to the government and how that has affected all the things you just talked about.
sentences.zh: 让我们从削减政府开支以及这如何影响你刚刚谈到的所有事情开始。

sentences.en: So it has, I think, potential effects in two different ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为它在两个不同的方面具有潜在影响。

sentences.en: One is just the direct effect, right?
sentences.zh: 一个是直接影响，对吧？

sentences.en: The layoffs of these workers, cancellation of programs, you know, rescinding of grants, right?
sentences.zh: 解雇这些工人、取消项目、你知道的，撤回资助，对吧？

sentences.en: All of that is real economic activity that has been pulled back.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是被收回的真实经济活动。

sentences.en: But the second piece of this is the confidence hit, right?
sentences.zh: 但第二部分是信心受到打击，对吧？

sentences.en: Musk and Trump have cut however many thousands of jobs it is at this point, but there are many more thousands of people who work for government contractors,
sentences.zh: 马斯克和特朗普到目前为止已经削减了成千上万个工作岗位，但还有更多成千上万的人为政府承包商工作，

sentences.en: who work for companies that sell to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 为向联邦政府销售产品的公司工作。

sentences.en: And you can imagine all of them and all of their employers are feeling pretty uncertain right now.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，所有这些人以及他们的雇主现在都感到相当不确定。

sentences.en: You look at what's happening in higher education, major universities saying that they're pausing all hiring, right?
sentences.zh: 看看高等教育领域正在发生的事情，各大大学表示他们正在暂停所有招聘，对吧？

sentences.en: These are, in many cases, good, pretty high-paying, you know, important jobs that then maybe have ripple effects of lots of other jobs.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，这些都是好的、薪酬相当高的、你知道的、重要的工作，然后可能会对许多其他工作产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: So this is how cutting government spending or threatening to withhold it starts to really affect consumer and business sentiment,
sentences.zh: 这就是削减政府开支或威胁扣减开支如何开始真正影响消费者和商业情绪，

sentences.en: and in this case, academic sentiment, but their hires as well.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，还有学术界的情绪，以及他们的招聘。

sentences.en: It has that potential, certainly within the sectors that are most directly affected, is clearly having a big impact.
sentences.zh: 它确实具有这种潜力，当然在受影响最直接的部门内，显然正在产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: You can think about it also on these programs, right?
sentences.zh: 你也可以在这些项目上考虑这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: If you rely on veterans' benefits right now, even if you have not had any difficulty getting your benefits.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在依赖退伍军人福利，即使你在获得福利时没有遇到任何困难。

sentences.en: The fact that thousands of people who work at the Veterans Affairs Department have just lost their jobs might influence how you feel about those benefits.
sentences.zh: 退伍军人事务部的数千名员工刚刚失业这一事实，可能会影响你对这些福利的看法。

sentences.en: And there are rumors about what the impact might be on benefits.
sentences.zh: 而且还有关于福利可能会受到什么影响的传言。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So these are all things that can have a sort of disruptive effect and that can lead people to pull back, can lead businesses to pull back on hiring.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是会产生某种破坏性影响的事情，可能会导致人们退缩，导致企业在招聘时退缩。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's how the president's approach to cutting the government significantly is impacting the feelings around the economy and, in some cases, behavior in the economy.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是总统大幅削减政府开支的方法如何影响对经济的感受，并在某些情况下影响经济行为。

sentences.en: Let's turn to his approach to tariffs and how that helps us understand these problematic numbers that you've been seeing over the past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向他的关税方法，以及这如何帮助我们理解你过去几周一直看到的这些有问题的数字。

sentences.en: Yeah, and in many ways, I think this is the big one.
sentences.zh: 是的，在许多方面，我认为这是最重要的一点。

sentences.en: The president has imposed sweeping tariffs on many of our trading partners on a huge range of goods.
sentences.zh: 总统对我们的许多贸易伙伴的巨额商品征收了广泛的关税。

sentences.en: Now, some of those tariffs have been paused.
sentences.zh: 现在，其中一些关税已经被暂停。

sentences.en: They've been delayed.
sentences.zh: 它们被推迟了。

sentences.en: They've been canceled, right?
sentences.zh: 它们被取消了，对吧？

sentences.en: But at least in theory, it can cover a huge amount of goods.
sentences.zh: 但至少在理论上，它可以涵盖数量巨大的商品。

sentences.en: And we know from economic research that what happens when you impose tariff rates is a tax on imports.
sentences.zh: 我们从经济研究中知道，当你征收关税税率时，发生的情况就是对进口商品征税。

sentences.en: What does that do?
sentences.zh: 那会怎样？

sentences.en: It raises prices.
sentences.zh: 它会推高价格。

sentences.en: And, you know, we often sit here, Michael, and we talk about the research says this, but Americans think this.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，迈克尔，我们经常坐在这里讨论研究是这么说的，但美国人是这么想的。

sentences.en: This is one case where Americans seem to have gotten the message from economists because in all of these surveys, it shows people think prices are going to be higher,
sentences.zh: 这是一个特例，美国人似乎从经济学家那里接收到了信息，因为在所有这些调查中，都显示人们认为价格将会更高，

sentences.en: and they specifically say because of tariffs.
sentences.zh: 并且他们明确表示是因为关税。

sentences.en: And we're seeing that hit in terms of consumers expecting to pay higher prices.
sentences.zh: 我们从消费者预期支付更高价格这一点上看到了这种冲击。

sentences.en: We're seeing that in businesses saying they expect to pay higher prices for the materials that go into their goods and then pass on those prices to consumers.
sentences.zh: 我们从企业表示它们预计其产品所需的原材料将支付更高价格、然后将这些价格转嫁给消费者这一点上看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And we're seeing at least some evidence of it in actual prices.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在实际价格中至少看到了其中的一些证据。

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve just this week came out and said there's some evidence at least that some of the recent pickup in goods inflation is the result of these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 就在本周，美联储站出来表示，至少有一些证据表明，近期商品通胀的回升是这些关税的结果。

sentences.en: Which means the tariffs are very quickly having a financial impact.
sentences.zh: 这意味着关税正在非常迅速地产生财务影响。

sentences.en: Which is what we would expect from the economic research.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们从经济研究中所预期的。

sentences.en: And I think that it's important to remember here,
sentences.zh: 我认为这里有一点很重要，需要记住，

sentences.en: Trump ran on a platform of curtailing inflation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选时的纲领是抑制通货膨胀。

sentences.en: He even said he would bring down prices.
sentences.zh: 他甚至说过他会降低价格。

sentences.en: And crucially, Americans who seem to believe him during the campaign that he would bring down prices or control inflation are now saying we're getting nervous
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在竞选期间似乎相信他会降低价格或控制通胀的美国人现在表示，我们开始感到紧张，

sentences.en: that this is going to mean higher prices, higher inflation.
sentences.zh: 担心这意味着更高的价格、更高的通胀。

sentences.en: Well, one reason why this nervousness seems understandable is that the president himself has started to change the way he talks about tariffs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这种紧张情绪看起来可以理解的一个原因，是总统本人已经开始改变他谈论关税的方式。

sentences.en: Now, he seems to be acknowledging that tariffs can actually really be disruptive to the economy.
sentences.zh: 现在，他似乎在承认关税实际上确实会对经济造成破坏。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've seen a real shift in messaging from the president himself and from members of his administration over the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，我们看到总统本人及其政府成员的信息传递发生了真正的转变。

sentences.en: Trump occasionally would acknowledge on the campaign trail maybe prices would come up temporarily under tariffs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在竞选期间偶尔会承认，在关税作用下，价格可能会暂时上涨。

sentences.en: But for the most part, right, what he was talking about was my policies are going to turn around the economy on day one.
sentences.zh: 但大多数情况下，对吧，他谈论的是我的政策将在第一天就扭转经济。

sentences.en: Next, I will direct all members of my cabinet to marshal the vast powers at their disposal to defeat what was record inflation and rapidly bring down costs and prices.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将指示内阁所有成员调动他们可支配的巨大权力，去战胜堪称创纪录的通胀，并迅速降低成本和价格。

sentences.en: And he said that even as recently as his inaugural address.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前的就职演说中，他也这么说过。

sentences.en: The American dream will soon be back and thriving like never before.
sentences.zh: 美国梦将很快回归并空前繁荣。

sentences.en: But over the last couple of weeks...
sentences.zh: 但在过去的几周里……

sentences.en: There's an adjustment.
sentences.zh: 有一个调整。

sentences.en: We will see whether there's pain.
sentences.zh: 我们将拭目以待是否会有痛苦。

sentences.en: Union members of his administration have started talking about a period of adjustment.
sentences.zh: 他政府中的工会成员开始谈论一个调整期。

sentences.en: There is a period of transition because what we're doing is very big.
sentences.zh: 这是一个转型期，因为我们正在做的事情非常宏大。

sentences.en: We're bringing wealth back to America.
sentences.zh: 我们正在把财富带回美国。

sentences.en: That's a big thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: A period of detox.
sentences.zh: 一个排毒期。

sentences.en: A period of pain.
sentences.zh: 一个痛苦期。

sentences.en: A period potentially of even recession.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是一个衰退期。

sentences.en: Yeah, he has notably refused to rule out the possibility of a recession, as have members of his administration.
sentences.zh: 是的，他显著地拒绝排除经济衰退的可能性，他的政府成员也是如此。

sentences.en: And look, economists would say you should never rule out the possibility of a recession.
sentences.zh: 听着，经济学家会说你永远不应该排除经济衰退的可能性。

sentences.en: So that's not inherently unreasonable.
sentences.zh: 所以这本身并不是不合理的。

sentences.en: But the tone has really shifted here from one of things will turn around on day one to there may be this period of pain, but it will pay off in the long run.
sentences.zh: 但这里的基调确实发生了转变，从“一切都会在第一天好转”转变为“可能会有这个痛苦期，但从长远来看是值得的”。

sentences.en: And it's worth highlighting here, if this recession happened, it would be specifically because of his policies.
sentences.zh: 这里值得强调的是，如果真的发生这场衰退，那将完全是因为他的政策。

sentences.en: It would be his tariffs, his uncertainty that's generating the pullback in activity that leads to the recession.
sentences.zh: 正是他的关税、他的不确定性导致了导致衰退的活动收缩。

sentences.en: That's something presidents often try to avoid even saying the word recession.
sentences.zh: 这是总统们通常尽量避免甚至说出“衰退”这个词的事情。

sentences.en: And here he's talking about potentially causing one.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，他却在谈论可能会引发一场衰退。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Is that a moment where we should give him points for candor or be startled by the fact that he's willing to pursue a set of policies
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们应该为他的坦率点赞的时刻，还是应该对以下事实感到震惊：他甘愿奉行一套政策，

sentences.en: that might bring us into a recession, which is never really any president's idea of a good set of policies?
sentences.zh: 这套政策可能会把我们带入经济衰退，而这在任何总统看来绝都不是一套好政策？

sentences.en: So, you know, I asked this question to a lot of economists over the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，在过去几周里，我向很多经济学家提出了这个问题。

sentences.en: And people will say, in theory, the idea of short-term pain for long-term gain can be reasonable, right?
sentences.zh: 人们会说，从理论上讲，为长远利益承受短期阵痛的想法是合理的，对吧？

sentences.en: This is harsh medicine, but we need it.
sentences.zh: 这是苦口良药，但我们确实需要它。

sentences.en: But you better be darn certain of the long-term gain.
sentences.zh: 但你最好确信能带来长远利益。

sentences.en: And what you hear almost universally from basically every economist, every expert is that is not what this is.
sentences.zh: 而你从基本上每一位经济学家、每一位专家那里几乎普遍听到的说法是，这根本不是那么回事。

sentences.en: First of all, there's really no need for this harsh medicine right now.
sentences.zh: 首先，现在根本不需要这种猛药。

sentences.en: The economy is in basically pretty decent shape.
sentences.zh: 经济状况基本上相当不错。

sentences.en: But secondly, this specific medicine, this isn't a harsh medicine, a chemotherapy that will generate a cure.
sentences.zh: 但其次，这种特定的药，这不是能带来治愈的猛药或化疗。

sentences.en: However, this is bloodletting, right?
sentences.zh: 相反，这是在放血，对吧？

sentences.en: This is a medicine that will actually make the problem worse.
sentences.zh: 这种药实际上只会让问题变得更糟。

sentences.en: What makes these economists confident that there won't be a golden era on the other end of this bloodletting, tough medicine, pain?
sentences.zh: 是什么让这些经济学家确信，在这场放血、猛药和阵痛之后，不会迎来一个黄金时代？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, I would go further, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我要说得更彻底一点，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not just that they're not certain there would be long-term gain.
sentences.zh: 不仅是他们不确定会有长远利益。

sentences.en: I mean, they're confident that these policies will not yield a long-term gain.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们坚信这些政策不会带来长远利益。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Look, anytime we say economists say, right, somebody should shock me, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，每当我们说“经济学家说”时，总得有人让我震惊一下，对吧？

sentences.en: Because economists think many, many different things.
sentences.zh: 因为经济学家的想法千差万别。

sentences.en: This is sort of like—
sentences.zh: 这有点像——

sentences.en: Shock.
sentences.zh: 震惊。

sentences.en: This is sort of the one thing that economists almost universally agree upon, is that tariffs are ultimately a damaging policy,
sentences.zh: 这是经济学家几乎普遍赞同的少数几件事之一，那就是关税终究是一项破坏性的政策，

sentences.en: or at least that these kinds of broad-based tariffs are a damaging policy.
sentences.zh: 或者至少这种广泛的关税是一项破坏性的政策。

sentences.en: Now, there are different reasons for this, and this is a complex subject.
sentences.zh: 当然，这背后有不同的原因，这是一个复杂的主题。

sentences.en: There are a lot of economists who reject the very idea that we need to re-industrialize the country in some way, right?
sentences.zh: 有很多经济学家甚至拒绝接受我们需要以某种方式重新让国家实现工业化的想法，对吧？

sentences.en: They argue that over the decades, free trade has left Americans better off on the whole, that even if it has hurt some people, that on average it has been beneficial.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，几十年来，自由贸易总体上让美国人生活得更好，即使它伤害了一些人，但平均而言它是有益的。

sentences.en: I think most economists would make that point,
sentences.zh: 我想大多数经济学家都会指出这一点，

sentences.en: but there's certainly been a lot of rethinking among at least some economists over the past couple of decades about the way that free trade has played out.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几十年里，至少某些经济学家对自由贸易的演变方式进行了很多反思。

sentences.en: Again, complicated subject.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是一个复杂的话题。

sentences.en: But I think the thing that there's pretty broad-based agreement about is we can't just turn the clock back.
sentences.zh: 但我认为大家达成广泛共识的一点是，我们无法让时光倒流。

sentences.en: We're not going to make T-shirts in this country again.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在这个国家重新生产T恤衫。

sentences.en: We're not going to make, you know, commodity furniture in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在这个国家生产，你知道的，日用家具。

sentences.en: And there are plenty of economists who would say we should be doing things now to preserve the manufacturing jobs that we do have.
sentences.zh: 还有很多经济学家会说，我们现在应该做些事情来保护我们现有的制造业工作岗位。

sentences.en: And especially in some important sectors, right?
sentences.zh: 特别是在一些重要的行业，对吧？

sentences.en: In robotics, in AI, in green energy, in chips.
sentences.zh: 比如机器人、人工智能、绿色能源和芯片。

sentences.en: These are areas where there may be real advantages to preserving the American manufacturing industry.
sentences.zh: 在这些领域，保护美国制造业可能确实存在真正的优势。

sentences.en: But broad-based tariffs of the kind that Trump is talking about are just not going to accomplish that.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普所谈论的那种广泛关税根本无法实现这一点。

sentences.en: But the president does not seem remotely deterred by what the economists say.
sentences.zh: 但总统似乎丝毫不为经济学家的言论所动摇。

sentences.en: He's undeterred, but in a way it's even worse than that, which is that so far he's been all over the map.
sentences.zh: 他没有动摇，但在某种程度上甚至更糟，那就是到目前为止他一直毫无章法、前后矛盾。

sentences.en: We've seen tariffs announced and then they've been delayed.
sentences.zh: 我们看到关税宣布后又被推迟。

sentences.en: They've been imposed and then they've been paused.
sentences.zh: 它们被实施后又被暂停。

sentences.en: In some cases within days.
sentences.zh: 有时在几天之内。

sentences.en: In some cases on the same day, right, within hours.
sentences.zh: 有时在同一天，对吧，甚至在几小时内。

sentences.en: And if you talk to businesses, right, they don't like tariffs.
sentences.zh: 如果你和企业交谈，对吧，他们不喜欢关税。

sentences.en: But what they really don't like is having no idea.
sentences.zh: 但他们真正不喜欢的是完全摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: They don't like uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢不确定性。

sentences.en: They don't like uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢不确定性。

sentences.en: If you're a business right now trying to decide where to buy your goods from, where to locate your factory, you have no idea what the policy is going to be a week, a month,
sentences.zh: 如果你现在是一家企业，正试图决定去哪里采购商品、把工厂建在哪里，你完全不知道一周、一个月后政策会变成什么样，

sentences.en: a year from now.
sentences.zh: 或者一年后会怎样。

sentences.en: And you could easily imagine businesses just sort of pressing pause and saying, you know what, let's hold off.
sentences.zh: 你很容易想象企业会按下暂停键，然后说，你知道吗，我们先观望一下。

sentences.en: Let's see where things are when the dust settles.
sentences.zh: 等尘埃落定再看看情况如何。

sentences.en: And that has real economic consequences if they're not hiring, if they're not investing, and the downstream of that, right,
sentences.zh: 如果他们不招聘、不投资，这就会产生真正的经济后果，而这会带来连锁反应，对吧，

sentences.en: so they're not hiring construction workers and they're not buying materials.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不雇佣建筑工人，也不购买材料。

sentences.en: All of that is the kind of thing that ripples through an economy and can cause a recession.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是那种在经济中产生涟漪并可能导致经济衰退的事情。

sentences.en: But you're saying the only certainty that has emerged from the first two months of this Trump economic agenda is uncertainty and, to some real degree, pain.
sentences.zh: 但你是说，从特朗普经济议程实施头两个月浮现出的唯一确定性，就是不确定性，并在某种程度上伴随着阵痛。

sentences.en: And so far, Trump seems okay with that.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，特朗普对此似乎并不介意。

sentences.en: I think there was an expectation on some level that he would change direction if the markets started to fall, if the economy started to sour.
sentences.zh: 我认为在某种程度上人们曾有一种预期：如果市场开始下跌，如果经济开始恶化，他会改变方向。

sentences.en: And maybe he will.
sentences.zh: 也许他会吧。

sentences.en: But so far, that has not been the reaction from him or from his administration.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他和他的政府并没有作出这种反应。

sentences.en: They seem to be saying, we'll take the pain and Americans are going to have to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在说，我们承受阵痛，美国人必须自己去应对。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Ben.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，本。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: After the break, Maggie Haberman on what the growing blowback over the economy has looked like from inside the White House.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，玛吉·哈伯曼将为您讲述白宫内部对经济政策的强烈反对之声究竟是怎样的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我是《连线》（Connections）游戏的作者，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一，我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母方块”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听觉”的奇特现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 里的 games 栏目，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, typically when economic data starts to show that a president's agenda is backfiring, the president tries to correct for it.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，通常当经济数据开始表明一位总统的议程正在产生反效果时，总统会试图进行纠正。

sentences.en: That does not seem to be the case here with President Trump, and you have been trying to understand what that looks like and why it is.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统身上似乎并非如此，而你一直在试图了解这究竟是怎么回事以及为什么会这样。

sentences.en: So tell us what you found.
sentences.zh: 所以请告诉我们你发现了什么。

sentences.en: So I think there are a few reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想原因有几个。

sentences.en: He believes in tariffs, not just as an economic tool, but as a good in and of themselves, as a revenue raiser, as a market corrector.
sentences.zh: 他坚信关税，不仅将其视为一种经济工具，而且将其视为一种本身就是好事的事物、一种创收手段、一种市场纠正机制。

sentences.en: He has been talking about tariffs since the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 他从20世纪80年代就开始谈论关税了。

sentences.en: He has had this mantra about applying tariffs on countries, quote-unquote, ripping us off forever.
sentences.zh: 他一直挂着这样一个口头禅：对那些用他原话来说“永远在坑害我们”的国家加征关税。

sentences.en: So that's one.
sentences.zh: 所以这是其一。

sentences.en: The other is he does see them as a tool.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是他的确将它们视为一种工具。

sentences.en: He also thinks that they are a way to impact other countries' behavior, and not just economically, but across a bunch of sectors.
sentences.zh: 他还认为这是影响其他国家行为的一种方式，不仅在经济上，而且跨越了多个领域。

sentences.en: Fentanyl in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 比如墨西哥的芬太尼问题。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But he's also mindful, and we had a lot of conversations with people about this, of not looking like a paper tiger.
sentences.zh: 但他也很注意——我们为此与许多人进行了交谈——不能让自己看起来像个纸老虎。

sentences.en: He does not want to be perceived as an empty suit on this.
sentences.zh: 他不想在这件事上被视为无能之辈。

sentences.en: He knows leaders in Europe and elsewhere are watching what he does on this, and so he does not want to look weak.
sentences.zh: 他知道欧洲和其他地方的领导人在密切关注他在这方面的举动，因此他不想显得软弱。

sentences.en: All that makes sense, but what Trump is doing now is much, much bigger when it comes to tariffs than what he did in his first term, and as a result,
sentences.zh: 所有这些都说得通，但特朗普现在在关税方面做的事情，比他第一任期时要宏大得多，因此，

sentences.en: the risk of potential economic costs is much higher than in the first term.
sentences.zh: 潜在经济成本的风险比第一任期时要高得多。

sentences.en: So far, it's not just been a wobbly stock market, but rapidly falling consumer confidence, for example,
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，不仅股市表现动荡，消费者的信心也在急剧下降，例如，

sentences.en: and yet none of those problematic data points are acting as any kind of a break on it.
sentences.zh: 然而所有这些有问题的据点并没有起到任何刹车的作用。

sentences.en: At least not so far, Michael.
sentences.zh: 至少目前还没有，迈克尔。

sentences.en: You are absolutely correct that this is a much broader scale of tariffs than what he tried doing in the first term,
sentences.zh: 你的看法完全正确，与他在第一任期内试图采取的举措相比，这次的关税规模要宏大得多，

sentences.en: and I think part of this is because he learned some lessons that may have been the wrong ones from the first term.
sentences.zh: 我认为部分原因是因为他从第一任期吸取了一些教训，而这些教训可能并不正确。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: So in term one, he had a group of advisors who were often at odds with each other about economic policy, but he had some really strong anti-tariff voices.
sentences.zh: 所以在第一任期，他有一群顾问，他们在经济政策上经常意见不一，但他有一些立场非常坚定的反对关税的声音。

sentences.en: Trump would suggest some version of an expansive tariff, and his anti-tariff economic advisors would strenuously object and push back very aggressively,
sentences.zh: 每当特朗普提出某种形式的大规模关税时，他那些反对关税的经济顾问就会强烈反对并进行极力抗击，

sentences.en: and Trump would then reverse course.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普就会改变方针。

sentences.en: And back off of that, Trump's lesson appears to have been things didn't go that badly.
sentences.zh: 并做出退让，而特朗普从中吸取的教训似乎是：事情其实并没有那么糟糕。

sentences.en: The market didn't crash completely.
sentences.zh: 市场并没有彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: Joe Biden kept some tariffs on in terms of China.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在对华关税方面也保留了一些关税。

sentences.en: My advisors were wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的顾问们错了。

sentences.en: Tariffs are good, and I can go bigger this time.
sentences.zh: 关税是好东西，这次我可以搞得更大。

sentences.en: But it was a very different economy then.
sentences.zh: 但那时的经济状况完全不同。

sentences.en: It was a much more thriving economy.
sentences.zh: 那是一个蓬勃发展得多的经济体。

sentences.en: It was a pre-coronavirus pandemic economy, among other things.
sentences.zh: 除其他外，这是一个冠状病毒疫情爆发前的经济体。

sentences.en: All of which is to say that Trump thinks the real lesson of term one when it comes to tariffs is that he went too small on tariffs, and the costs were low.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都说明，谈到关税时，特朗普认为第一任期真正的教训是当时关税动作太小了，而成本很低。

sentences.en: And if he can finally go much bigger on tariffs now in term two, because he's got the right advisors in place, the payoffs will be much bigger.
sentences.zh: 如果他现在在第二任期最终能够把关税规模搞得大得多，因为他组建了合适的顾问团队，回报也会大得多。

sentences.en: The costs will remain low.
sentences.zh: 成本依然会保持在较低水平。

sentences.en: But that feels like a real apples to oranges kind of comparison.
sentences.zh: 但这感觉真像是把苹果和橘子放在一起作比较。

sentences.en: It is kind of apples and oranges in a very different economy.
sentences.zh: 在一个截然不同的经济体里，这确实有点像拿苹果比作橘子。

sentences.en: Are there people inside the administration saying to the president, look, Mr. President, of course we understand why you want to push for tariffs.
sentences.zh: 政府内部有没有人对总统说：听着，总统先生，我们当然理解您为什么想要推动关税政策。

sentences.en: We know how central it is to your message and your belief system.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这对于您的核心信息和信念体系有多么重要。

sentences.en: But you should know you're not really communicating it quite right.
sentences.zh: 但您应该知道，您并没有真正把它表达清楚。

sentences.en: And the markets are very anxious about it.
sentences.zh: 而且市场对此感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Perhaps there's something you can do differently.
sentences.zh: 也许有些事情您可以换个方式来做。

sentences.en: There is a clear understanding in the administration that there is some whipsawing going on.
sentences.zh: 政府内部确实有一种明确的共识，即政策正在反复摇摆。

sentences.en: So there was this meeting a week ago about how to handle the messaging at the Naval Observatory, which is the vice president's residence.
sentences.zh: 因此，一周前在副总统官邸海军天文台曾召开过一次会议，讨论如何处理信息传达问题。

sentences.en: And there was Howard Lutnick, the Commerce Secretary, Susie Wiles, the White House chief of staff, Jameson Greer, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 出席会议的有商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克、白宫办公厅主任苏西·维尔斯、美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔，

sentences.en: trade representative, among others.
sentences.zh: 以及其他一些人。

sentences.en: Some big shots.
sentences.zh: 都是些大人物。

sentences.en: Big shots, very important voices in this discussion.
sentences.zh: 大人物，这场讨论中非常重要的声音。

sentences.en: And as we understand it, it was about dealing with the messaging and explaining to the public what is happening, trying to better explain what the tariffs are,
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，会议的重点是处理信息传达，向公众解释正在发生的事情，试图更好地解释什么是关税，

sentences.en: when they might be coming.
sentences.zh: 以及它们何时可能会出台。

sentences.en: I haven't seen much evidence that that yielded a change in approach.
sentences.zh: 我还没有看到太多证据表明这带来了处理方式上的改变。

sentences.en: But its existence suggests that there's an understanding among the president's top aides and economic advisors that there's a problem here.
sentences.zh: 但它的存在表明，总统的高级幕僚和经济顾问们已经意识到这里存在一个问题。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they are never really able to say the problem is partly stemming from the top.
sentences.zh: 而且他们永远无法真正说出问题部分源于最高层。

sentences.en: So it has to be how does the lower tier of people just below him deal with this when they're talking to television cameras and to reporters as opposed to saying the president is saying things that are complicated and revoluted.
sentences.zh: 所以当紧随其下的低层官员面对电视摄像机和记者时，他们只能去设法应对，而不是去指出总统说的话既复杂又反复无常。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I've watched some of those interviews, and it seems worth saying how complicated it has become.
sentences.zh: 我看过其中一些采访，我觉得有必要指出它已经变得多么复杂。

sentences.en: I've seen the president's economic advisors go on TV and get asked a question like,
sentences.zh: 我看到总统的经济顾问上电视时被问到这样的问题：

sentences.en: can you please help us understand why the president is now saying that this new approach to tariffs might ultimately bring us into a recession?
sentences.zh: 您能帮我们理解一下，为什么总统现在说这种应对关税的新方法最终可能会让我们陷入经济衰退吗？

sentences.en: And the question is basically like, isn't that bad?
sentences.zh: 这个问题基本上是在问：这难道不是一件坏事吗？

sentences.en: Don't you not want that?
sentences.zh: 难道这不是你们所不希望看到的吗？

sentences.en: And then the advisor then has to turn around and say, well, it would be a small recession.
sentences.zh: 然后这位顾问不得不转过头来说，嗯，那将是一场小幅度的衰退。

sentences.en: But it's a very tough position to put your economic aides in.
sentences.zh: 但把你们的经济幕僚置于这种境地，实在是太难为人了。

sentences.en: It's an untenable position.
sentences.zh: 这是一个站不住脚的立场。

sentences.en: And the two people who are out there the most talking about this tariff program are two financiers, Howard Lutnick, the Commerce Secretary, and Scott Besant,
sentences.zh: 而最常出面谈论这个关税计划的两个人是两位金融家：商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克和财政部长斯科特·贝森特。

sentences.en: the Treasury Secretary.
sentences.zh: 财政部长。

sentences.en: And so they are describing an economic program that clearly has not been their lifelong economic exposure and project.
sentences.zh: 因此他们正在描述一个经济计划，这显然并非他们毕生所从事的经济领域和项目。

sentences.en: And so there are inherent contradictions, as you said, in what they are trying to tell the public they should take from this.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他们试图告诉公众应该从中领会什么，这其中存在着内在的矛盾。

sentences.en: And I don't really see that resolving anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且我真的看不出这能在短期内得到解决。

sentences.en: You seem to be suggesting that on some level they might not really believe in this set of policies, but they do have to defend it.
sentences.zh: 你似乎在暗示，在某种程度上，他们可能并不真的相信这一套政策，但他们又必须为之辩护。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And to be fair to them and to the president, the president's agenda is the agenda.
sentences.zh: 而且公平地说，对他们和总统而言，总统的议程就是议程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In any administration, this is a president who he is not consistent on a number of things, but he has been very consistent about tariffs for a very long time,
sentences.zh: 在任何政府中，这位总统在许多事情上可能并不一致，但在关税问题上，他长期以来一直非常一致，

sentences.en: long before he became a candidate.
sentences.zh: 早在成为候选人之前就很一致了。

sentences.en: And if you're going to serve a president, you should be expected that you're going to be asked to defend their policies.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算为一位总统服务，你就应该预料到自己会被要求为他们的政策进行辩护。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But often, and particularly with Lutnick, the conversation in interviews swings to the president's a genius.
sentences.zh: 但通常，特别是在谈到卢特尼克时，采访中的话题总是会转向总统是个天才。

sentences.en: You know, he knows exactly what he's doing, which doesn't do much to assuage the markets or concerned voters.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他非常清楚自己在做什么，但这对于平息市场或担忧的选民并没有起到太大作用。

sentences.en: What does President Trump say or think about the fact that the majority of economists fundamentally disagree with him about the long-term prospects for tariffs?
sentences.zh: 对于大多数经济学家根本不赞同他关于关税长期前景的看法这件事，特朗普总统是怎么说或者怎么想的？

sentences.en: We just talked about this with Ben Castleman.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚和本·卡斯特尔曼谈过这个。

sentences.en: He said that there's pretty clearly a consensus that the short-term pain won't necessarily lead to the long-term gain of reindustrialization across the United States as a result of these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他说，各方有相当明确的共识，即由于这些关税，短期阵痛未必能带来美国全境再工业化的长期收益。

sentences.en: So what you may end up getting is not just short-term pain, but long-term pain without much gain.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终得到的可能不仅是短期阵痛，还有没什么收益的长期痛苦。

sentences.en: The president thinks the experts are wrong, which is what the president has thought on a number of fronts.
sentences.zh: 总统认为专家们错了，这也是总统在许多问题上的一贯看法。

sentences.en: And again, to be fair to him, he has been shown in very specific circumstances that that has been true.
sentences.zh: 而且话说回来，客观地讲，在非常具体的情况下，事实确实证明他是对的。

sentences.en: That can be true.
sentences.zh: 那可能是真的。

sentences.en: It can be true.
sentences.zh: 这完全可能发生。

sentences.en: And maybe his own poll numbers will be impacted to such an extent, his approval numbers will be impacted to such an extent that he changes course,
sentences.zh: 也许他自己的民调支持率会受到很大影响，他的满意度会受到如此巨大的冲击，以至于他不得不改变方针，

sentences.en: that he takes a dramatic action of some kind.
sentences.zh: 采取某种戏剧性的行动。

sentences.en: This is definitely a concern for his advisors who are worried about the impact on his political standing, which at the moment, they don't blame on voter response to tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是他的顾问们所担心的事情，他们担心这会影响他的政治地位，而目前他们并不认为这是选民对关税的反应导致的。

sentences.en: And they don't even really blame it on the stock market reaction.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不认为这主要是股市反应造成的。

sentences.en: They think that the ongoing nature of elevated consumer prices, eggs, so forth, is what is hurting Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，持续高位的消费品价格、鸡蛋等等，才是真正损害特朗普的原因。

sentences.en: That may not be the case forever.
sentences.zh: 这种情况可能不会永远持续下去。

sentences.en: But Trump so far has not seen anything that has convinced him that he is wrong.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，特朗普还没有看到任何能让他确信自己错了的东西。

sentences.en: And Trump is making, Michael, this enormous gamble.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，特朗普正在进行一场巨大的豪赌。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: On his economic policy and on the idea that everybody else is wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是一场关于他的经济政策、以及其他人全都错了这一信念的赌博。

sentences.en: And Trump makes these massive gambles.
sentences.zh: 特朗普经常做出这种巨大的豪赌。

sentences.en: Sometimes they really don't work out for him.
sentences.zh: 有时结果确实很不理想。

sentences.en: Sometimes they do.
sentences.zh: 但有时也确实成功了。

sentences.en: And he takes those moments as affirmation that he was correct all along.
sentences.zh: 而他会把这些时刻当作对他一贯正确的肯定。

sentences.en: Is it right to think Donald Trump is kind of gambling his second term on tariffs?
sentences.zh: 认为唐纳德·特朗普是在用关税拿自己的第二个任期来冒险，这种看法对吗？

sentences.en: To some extent.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上是的。

sentences.en: I don't think the entirety of it.
sentences.zh: 我不认为全部如此。

sentences.en: But certainly the short-term economic picture and possibly the long-term, he is waging an enormous bet that his view of the economy is going to be correct.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，就短期经济前景以及可能的长期前景而言，他正在下一场巨大的赌注，坚信自己对经济的看法是正确的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the face, to your point, of almost everyone's expert opinion as to why this approach is risky.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，尽管几乎所有专家的意见都认为这种做法充满风险，他依然如此。

sentences.en: So this has been very confusing for people to figure out what exactly the endgame is.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们很难搞清楚最终结局究竟会是什么。

sentences.en: Well, the endgame one might presume, and you've hinted at this, is that the polls are pretty important to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们可能会推测——你也暗示过这一点——民调对唐纳德·特朗普来说非常重要。

sentences.en: He's never seemed to have a long-term stomach for unpopularity.
sentences.zh: 他似乎从来没有长期承受不受欢迎状态的肚量。

sentences.en: And everything you've said here suggests that he might be able to disregard the markets for a while and the views of Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 你刚才所说的一切都表明，他或许能够暂时不理会市场和华尔街的看法。

sentences.en: He doesn't need re-election.
sentences.zh: 他不需要再次竞选连任。

sentences.en: And he fundamentally believes in tariffs and has for a very long time and thinks he didn't get a shot to do it as big as he wished in the first term.
sentences.zh: 而且他打心底里坚信关税的作用，并且坚持了很长时间，他认为自己在第一任期内没有机会随心所欲地大干一场。

sentences.en: So he's going to do it in this term.
sentences.zh: 所以他要在这一任期里实现。

sentences.en: But if in a year, year and a half, two years,
sentences.zh: 但如果过了一年、一年半、两年，

sentences.en: we're looking at polling that shows that the majority of Americans think he's mishandling the economy and prices are up and the long-term gain isn't arrived,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的民调显示，大多数美国人认为他把经济搞砸了，物价上涨了，长期收益没有兑现，

sentences.en: but the short-term pain is very present.
sentences.zh: 而短期的痛苦却历历在目。

sentences.en: And don't we expect that he would change his approach to these tariffs?
sentences.zh: 难道我们不觉得他会改变对待这些关税的方式吗？

sentences.en: Or is the answer, no, not at all, because he really thinks that the only way to prove the experts wrong is to remain committed to it?
sentences.zh: 还是说答案是：不，完全不会，因为他坚信证明专家错误的的唯一方法就是死磕到底？

sentences.en: So, Michael, I think that there will be competing impulses at play in Donald Trump's head as he is grappling with this.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，我认为在唐纳德·特朗普应对这一局势时，他的脑海中会有相互冲突的冲动在交织。

sentences.en: On the one hand, he is going to want to stick to his guns.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他会想要坚持己见。

sentences.en: This is something I think he does believe in.
sentences.zh: 这是他深信不疑的事情。

sentences.en: And I think he's going to want to show the experts that he's right.
sentences.zh: 我想他会想向专家们证明他是对的。

sentences.en: But on the other, there is an external reality, which is that he is not on the ballot again, but his party is.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，存在着一个客观现实，那就是他本人虽然不再参选，但他的党派还要参选。

sentences.en: In the next midterm.
sentences.zh: 在下一次中期选举中。

sentences.en: In the next midterMs.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的中期选举里。

sentences.en: And the Republicans have a very, very narrow majority in the House.
sentences.zh: 而共和党在众议院的多数席位非常非常微弱。

sentences.en: Trump and his advisors are extremely aware that if they lose the midterms, the number of investigations and subpoenas that they will face from a Democratic House will be vaSt.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和他的顾问们非常清楚，如果他们在中期选举中失利，民主党掌控的众议院将会向他们发起铺天盖地的调查和传唤。

sentences.en: And that's not something they want to spend the final two years of his term dealing with.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是他们想在总统任期的最后两年里应付的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And nothing can cost an incumbent president control of Congress more than a problematic economy, high prices.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比糟糕的经济、高昂的物价，更能夺走一个在任总统对国会的控制权了。

sentences.en: And appearing to seem as if you don't hear voters' concerns about them.
sentences.zh: 并且让人觉得你对选民的这些担忧充耳不闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Trump might be willing to gamble on the country's future economically, but I think he's far less willing to gamble with his own political fortunes.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普或许愿意拿国家的经济未来去冒险，但我认为他远没有那么愿意拿自己个人的政治命运去豪赌。

sentences.en: Well, Maggie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛吉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Today, we take a very historic action that was 45 years in the making.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们采取了一项具有历史意义的行动，这项行动历时45年才得以实现。

sentences.en: In a few moments, I will sign an executive order to begin eliminating the federal Department of Education once and for all.
sentences.zh: 稍后，我将签署一项行政令，开始一劳永逸地废除联邦教育部。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump signed an executive order instructing his education secretary to begin dismantling the Department of Education.
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统签署了一项行政令，指示其教育部长开始解散教育部。

sentences.en: And it sounds strange, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 听起来很不可思议，对吧？

sentences.en: Department of Education, we're going to eliminate it.
sentences.zh: 教育部，我们要把它撤销了。

sentences.en: And everybody knows it's right.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道这是对的。

sentences.en: Because the department was created by an act of Congress, it cannot be shut down without congressional action, something Trump called for on Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 由于该部门是根据国会法案设立的，未经国会采取行动是无法将其关闭的，特朗普在周四晚上也呼吁这样做。

sentences.en: For now, the department will continue to carry out functions required by law, such as administering federal student aid and funding for special education.
sentences.zh: 目前，教育部将继续履行法律规定的职能，例如管理联邦学生资助和特殊教育经费。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that Elon Musk's already enormous access and influence within the federal government are set to expand later today when he is briefed on the US military's plans for any future war with China.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，埃隆·马斯克在联邦政府内部已经极其庞大的权限和影响力，将在今天晚些时候进一步扩大，届时他将听取美军关于未来对华战争计划的简报。

sentences.en: That briefing will likely highlight Musk's many conflicts of interest, since he runs multiple businesses that hold government contracts, including with the Department of Defense.
sentences.zh: 这场简报很可能会凸显马斯克身上存在的诸多利益冲突，因为他经营着多家与政府持有合同的企业，其中就包括国防部。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mary Wilson, Will Reed, and Rochelle Bonja.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊、威尔·里德和罗谢尔·邦贾制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Chris Haxel.
sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治和克里斯·哈克塞尔剪辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marian Lozano and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Babarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们准备节日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App上或在您喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索收听《Wirecutter秀》。
